999008199.text: ただいまーっと
え、ヴァレリア！？
レスナ、色々面倒なことになっててね……

localizations.en: Resna, things have gotten pretty complicated over there...

999008199.text:
大変……陰陽師のコウセンがやっぱり黒幕で、
アルビーナたちが捕まっちゃったなんて

localizations.en: How terrible... So the diviner Kosen really was the mastermind, and Alvina and the others got captured?

999008199.text: そういうわけで、レスナたちも増援に来てほしいの！

localizations.en: That's why I need you and the others to come as reinforcements!

999008199.text:
もちろん！　実は、こっちでも色々あって……
私たちもケイウンに向かうつもりだったの

localizations.en: Of course! We've actually had our own troubles here as well... And we were planning to head to Keiun anyway.

999008199.text:
九偉人が私たちの所にやって来てね。どうやら、彼らも
ケイウンの騒動に手を出そうと動いているらしい

localizations.en: The Palme came to see us. Apparently, they're making moves to interfere in Keiun as well.

999008199.text: ええっ！　コウセンだけでも大変なのに……！

localizations.en: What?! As if dealing with Kosen wasn't enough...!

999008199.text:
あの人たちを放っておいたら、
ケイウンがどうなるか……

localizations.en: If we leave those people unchecked, who knows what'll happen to Keiun...

999008199.text: 向こうで彼らを見かけたりしなかったかい？

localizations.en: You didn't happen to see them over there, did you?

999008199.text:
いいえ、見てないわ。
もしかしたら、すれ違いになったかも

localizations.en: No, I didn't see them. We might have missed them on the way.

999008199.text:
向こうに残ったララたちと
かち合ってないといいけど……

localizations.en: I just hope they don't run into Lara and the others who stayed behind...

999008199.text:
アルビーナたちを助けに行くついでに、
そっちも止めないとね！

localizations.en: We'll have to stop them while we're rescuing Alvina and the others!

999008199.text: できれば私もついて行きたいところだが……

localizations.en: I'd like to come along if possible, but...

999008199.text: ロマン君はダメ！　捕まって身分がばれたら大変だよ！

localizations.en: No way! If you get caught and they figure out who you are, it'll be a disaster!

999008199.text:
分かっているとも……大人しくここで待っているよ。
事態が落ち着いたら、改めて挨拶に赴くことにしよう

localizations.en: That's a valid point... I'll wait here quietly then. Once things settle down, I'll make a proper visit.

999008199.text:
そういえば、アルビーナからレシピを
預かってきたって言ってたよね

localizations.en: Oh right, you said you brought back a recipe from Alvina?

999008199.text: ああ、そうそう。これなんだけど……

localizations.en: Oh, that's right. Here it is...

999008199.text:
うーんと……この「仙人の実」っていうのは
もしかしてケイウン固有のもの……？

localizations.en: Let's see... This 'Sage Fruit'—could it be something unique to Keiun...?

999008199.text:
それはちゃんと用意してあるわ。
アルビーナたちが捕まる前に見つけておいてくれたの

localizations.en: We've already got that covered. Alvina and the others found it before they were captured.

999008199.text:
それ以外は神聖国で採れるもので代用できそうだし……
うん、なるほど、これなら作れそうだね

localizations.en: Everything else looks like we can substitute with materials from Nova... Yeah, I think we can make this.

999008199.text:
それじゃ、急いで素材を集めて作っちゃいましょ。
ユミアたちもアトリエで待ってるから

localizations.en: Then let's hurry and gather the materials to make it. Yumia and the others are waiting at the atelier.
